summary: Independent re-verification of ORA Chat MCP (Part A). Backend: ran /app/backend/tests/test_mcp_ora_chat_admin.py — 13/13 passed against the preview BASE URL. Extra curl checks confirmed: create-key returns raw 'key' starting with 'oraadm_mcp_' + 'key_doc' with NO 'key_hash', defaults are rate_limit_per_min=60 and spend_cap_monthly_usd=50, list-keys includes current_month_spend_usd/spend_pct/over_alert_threshold fields, revoke returns {ok:true}. Non-admin JWT is server-side rejected with 403 on both POST and GET /admin/gateway/keys. Frontend: /admin/api-keys shows 'ORA CHAT — MCP' card with 'ADMIN ONLY' badge below the pre-existing sk-aurem MCP keys section, MCP URL + Copy, label input + '+ Generate MCP key', 'Test (ask_ora_chat: ping)' button, and a keys table with columns Key/Label, Last used, Rate limit, Spend this month ($0.00 / $50), Status, Action (Regenerate/Revoke). Clicking Generate reveals a one-time banner 'COPY THIS NOW — IT WON'T BE SHOWN AGAIN' with the full raw key, Copy + 'I've saved it' buttons, and Claude Desktop setup line ('Claude Desktop -> Settings -> Connectors -> Add custom connector -> ... Advanced settings -> Request headers -> Authorization = Bearer oraadm_mcp_...'). After page reload the raw key is NOT shown anywhere (regex for oraadm_mcp_[20+ chars] returned 0 matches); only truncated 'oraadm_mcp_XxXxXx…' prefixes appear in the table. Clicking 'Test (ask_ora_chat: ping)' returned the clean error message 'ORA Chat call failed: llm_api_key_missing' within a few seconds (no stack trace, no infinite spinner) — matches the documented, pre-existing, out-of-scope gap. MCP Inspector step skipped (curl tools/list substitute already covered).
action_items: (Out-of-scope reminder, not a bug in this feature) Configure a working API key for the role='chat' entry in services/llm_config_store.py so ask_ora_chat can produce a real reply in this preview — currently correctly surfaces llm_api_key_missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature is well-scoped and matches the spec: bearer-key auth (OAuth explicitly deferred), key hashed + shown once, admin-only enforced server-side (nonadmin JWT gets 403 via curl, not just UI hiding), rate limit + spend cap defaults 60/$50 exposed on the model, spend_pct + over_alert_threshold fields present on list response for the >=80% badge.
MCP JSON-RPC endpoint returns 200 with a JSON-RPC 'error' body for tool-level failures (unknown tool, conversation not found, llm_api_key_missing) — correct per JSON-RPC 2.0.
Revoked key immediately rejected on the MCP endpoint (403), confirming no stale-cache window.
